_comment: Phase 110 (V13-PLAN.md) UI-wiring CI guard allowlist. See scripts/check-ui-wiring.js and ARCHITECTURE.md for the wiring conventions this documents. Every entry below was traced to the code that actually binds it (2026-09-26 triage, backlog 9c) — an entry is a statement that the control IS wired, by a route the static regexes cannot follow. Do NOT add entries to silence a warning you have not traced.
_retired_2026-09-26: The 7 bir-*-csv entries and e-vat were removed: check-ui-wiring.js now understands the `csvId:`/`saveBtnId:`/`targetId:` declarative keys, so window.birToolbarHTML({csvId}) and window.vatFieldHTML(id, def) resolve on their own.

getElementById.page-panel: assigned via el.id = 'page-panel' in js/app.js (createElement pattern), never a literal id= in a template
getElementById.bi-toast: assigned via el.id = 'bi-toast' in js/notifications.js (createElement pattern)
getElementById.worker-profile-panel: assigned via el.id = 'worker-profile-panel' in js/app.js (createElement pattern)
getElementById.epstat-sss-amt: rendered as id="epstat-${k}-amt" in js/screens/employee-profile.js:739 — the statutory rows are generated from a key loop, so no literal id= exists for any of the four. Read back via panel.querySelector('#epstat-sss-amt') at :798.
getElementById.file-input-vt-upload: js/drive.js:320 renders id="file-input-${containerId}"; js/screens/ventures.js:938 looks it up with containerId 'vt-upload' (the ventures source even comments the indirection). Cross-file dynamic id — unresolvable statically.
getElementById.upload-label-vt-upload: same js/drive.js:309 id="upload-label-${containerId}" indirection as file-input-vt-upload
getElementById.upload-status-vt-upload: same js/drive.js:341 id="upload-status-${containerId}" indirection as file-input-vt-upload
getElementById.add-expense-btn: NOT a real lookup — the only occurrence in the tree is an audit comment at js/app.js:4762 recording that '#add-expense-btn' never existed. The scanner's '#id'-literal rule cannot tell code from comment text.

unboundControls.ep-sss-mode: bound through a data-driven id table: _epStatPairs = [['ep-sss-mode','ep-sss'],...] at js/screens/hr.js:2197, iterated into panel.querySelector('#'+modeId) at :2200. The id is a bare string in an array, so no regex can tie it to the rendered <select>.
unboundControls.hrp-stat-sss-mode: read via the bare-id helper _wpModeOf('hrp-stat-sss-mode') at js/screens/hr.js:3463 — a non-$-prefixed helper, so outside the $helper('id') convention the scanner understands.
